messages:
Alex G: Heads-up — we pushed nvidia-driver-535 to staging canary 03 at 09:07 and 4/8 nodes failed to boot (eu-central). DKMS errors in /var/log/syslog. Rolling this to prod would be bad. :warning:
Maria S: seeing the same in eu-central A100 pool. kernel headers mismatch: 'ERROR: Cannot find the sources of your current Linux kernel (5.15.0-1013-generic)'.
Samir: quick log snippet i grabbed:```
Nov 17 09:09:12 node-03 dkms: nvidia 535.54.03: running module version sanity check
Nov 17 09:09:12 node-03 dkms: nvidia 535.54.03: ERROR: Could not locate the kernel headers for kernel 5.15.0-1013-generic
Nov 17 09:09:12 node-03 systemd[1]: Started Raise network interfaces.
Nov 17 09:09:13 node-03 systemd-modules-load[240]: Failed to find module 'nvidia'
```
ops-bot: [auto-alert] canary-failure: driver-upgrade-535 — 4/8 nodes non-operational in eu-central. Investigate.
Jen P: Is this only on HWE kernels or all? Our ubuntu-2204 AMIs have mixed kernels because of previous security backports.
Maria S: looks correlated to 5.15 patched kernels from image-builder; nodes with 5.19 and 6.x are OK.
Mark R: also noticed several training jobs hit NCCL timeouts after the upgrade on nodes that did boot: repeated ``allreduce: timeout`` and hangs during multi-GPU steps. Might be version skew between userland nv and kernel module.
Kyle: quick triage: if dkms can't find headers, the module never builds — the package pulls in nvidia-kernel-source which expects exact headers. We need to either install the exact linux-headers or skip DKMS and use prebuilt module.
Alex G: Proposed immediate actions: 1) pause rollout to remaining canaries, 2) rollback canary nodes to driver-525 package snapshot, 3) add a kernel-headers check to our upgrade job, 4) run full repro on a staging node with same AMI/kernel. Thoughts? :eyes:
Samir: +1. For rollback: plan is to apt install nvidia-driver-525 from our apt mirror and update-initramfs then reboot. Commands:```
sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525
sudo update-initramfs -u -k all
sudo reboot
```
Jen P: We should also add a preflight in image-builder that verifies 'dkms status' and runs 'dkms autoinstall' in a container matching target kernel. If autoinstall fails, fail the driver package rollout.
Maria S: For nodes that already fail to boot, rescue mode works: mount the root, chroot, install linux-headers-$(uname -r) or apt remove nvidia-dkms then install prebuilt module. Example rescue steps in runbook:```
mount /dev/nvme0n1p1 /mnt
for d in /sys/devices/virtual/dmi/id/* ; do cat $d ; done # to verify image
chroot /mnt /bin/bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y linux-headers-5.15.0-1013-generic
apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525
update-initramfs -u
exit
reboot
```
Mark R: Also recommend adding a check in our CI that runs a tiny NCCL allreduce across 2 gpus after driver install to catch userland/kernel API mismatches. We had a similar silent regression last year.
ops-bot: [note] created incident-1234 in incidents channel and linked this thread.
Alex G: Can we also gate driver upgrades by instance family? H100 nodes use driver-550+ but A100 still fine on 525/535 combos; mixing families in a single rollout creates cross-compat issues.
Kyle: Yes — split rollouts by gpu-family and kernel-series. Add matrix: {A100: 525/535 validated, H100: 550+ validated}. I'll create a small matrix in the infra repo.
Samir: Cost note: we took some Dedicated capacity OOMs because autoscaler kept spinning replacement nodes that failed boot — extra hourly charge in eu-central yesterday ~ $1.7k. Need to capture that in postmortem.
Jen P: Agreed. I'll start a short postmortem draft and include mitigation timeline + we should add an automatic hold if >2 nodes fail in the same pool during a rollout.
Maria S: For long-term: parameterize DKMS vs packaged module in AMI builds. Prefer prebuilt kernel module in images we distribute for production to avoid DKMS churn.
Alex G: OK action items: pause rollout (Kyle), rollback affected canaries to 525 (Samir), add kernel-headers check to rollout job (Jen), create GPU-family rollout matrix (Kyle), add NCCL smoke to CI (Mark). I'll update incident-1234 and ping CS for customer impact.
Samir: I'm starting rollback now on canary-03. Will post progress.
Alex G: thanks — please tag here when complete. :thumbsup:
Samir: rollback done on 03 at 10:02; nodes back to Ready. Replacing remaining canaries paused.
Maria S: adding note: watch for DKMS build logs on any future kernel patch bundles, and verify that our image-builder pins exact header package names.
Kyle: I pushed the initial GPU-family matrix PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/driver-rollout-matrix/pull/5 — please review.
Jen P: Postmortem draft started: https://docs.redwood.ai/infra/postmortems/driver-535-upgrade.md — I'll loop SRE and Product for impact assessment.
Alex G: Great work. We'll re-run a controlled upgrade once we've added preflight checks and NCCL smoke. Until then, hold all driver-535/550+ rollouts.
